target: Verify ISS-2977: confirm whether the digest-reviews.js under-covered-processed-reviews trend (256/1205 last week -> 257/1206 this run) is genuinely shrinking, plateauing, or masking a single WIN/review silently accumulating untracked holes.
tldr_evidence: Fresh re-run of digest-reviews.js confirms 257 under-covered processed reviews / 1206 missing-issue holes (up from 256/1205 last week). Diffing this run's full per-WIN breakdown against the committed 2026-07-13 snapshot (commit 58995c2) shows zero existing entries grew and zero were resolved -- the entire +1/+1 delta is exactly one brand-new entry (overview-headline-killshots-EXP-653, gap=1), which corresponds to EXP-653 being freshly integrated and marked processed in commit 544fdf7. No WIN or review is silently accumulating untracked holes; the backlog is static except for new reviews entering it at their initial (small) gap.
tldr_verdict: Trend framing should be 'flat/plateauing' rather than strictly 'shrinking' week-over-week (268 -> 259 -> 256 -> 257 over the last four comparable checks is noisy near-flat, not monotonic decline), but the underlying finding remains purely informational: no single WIN/review is silently growing, so no code investigation of digest-reviews.js is warranted at this time. Recommend closing ISS-2977 as verified-no-action-needed.

This does not change the recommended action -- the finding remains informational because no single item is growing.
